items.source: Returns the methods of the given bean class.
items.translation: 返回给定 Bean 类的方法。

items.source: This class scans a list of objects for methods annotated with McpElicitation and creates Function callbacks for them. These callbacks can be used to handle elicitation requests from MCP servers.
items.translation: 该类会扫描对象列表，查找带有 McpElicitation 注解的方法，并为其创建 Function 回调。这些回调可用于处理来自 MCP 服务器的请求。

items.source: elicitationObjects - the objects containing methods annotated with McpElicitation
items.translation: elicitationObjects - 包含用 McpElicitation 注解的方法的对象。

items.source: IllegalStateException - if no elicitation methods are found or if multiple elicitation methods are found
items.translation: IllegalStateException - 如果未找到任何激发方法，或者找到了多个激发方法时

items.source: the methods of the bean class

items.translation: 同步提示回调的提供者。

items.source:
// Create a provider with a list of objects containing @McpElicitation methods
SyncMcpElicitationProvider provider = new SyncMcpElicitationProvider(List.of(elicitationHandler));

// Get the elicitation handler
Function<ElicitRequest, ElicitResult> elicitationHandler = provider.getElicitationHandler();

// Add the handler to the client features
McpClientFeatures.Sync clientFeatures = new McpClientFeatures.Sync(
    clientInfo, clientCapabilities, roots,
    toolsChangeConsumers, resourcesChangeConsumers, promptsChangeConsumers,
    loggingConsumers, samplingHandler, elicitationHandler);
items.translation:
// 创建一个包含带有 @McpElicitation 方法的对象列表的提供者
SyncMcpElicitationProvider provider = new SyncMcpElicitationProvider(List.of(elicitationHandler));

// 获取 elicitation 处理器
Function<ElicitRequest, ElicitResult> elicitationHandler = provider.getElicitationHandler();

// 将处理器添加到客户端功能中
McpClientFeatures.Sync clientFeatures = new McpClientFeatures.Sync(
    clientInfo, clientCapabilities, roots,
    toolsChangeConsumers, resourcesChangeConsumers, promptsChangeConsumers,
    loggingConsumers, samplingHandler, elicitationHandler);
